source_register.title: Guia de implementação dos procedimentos de devolução no Pix, com ênfase no MED, version 4.2
supports: Recovery graph starts at a root transaction and maps subsequent transfers to which suspected fraud proceeds were diverted
Downstream recipient PSPs can receive linked notifications and block requested amounts under Pix rules
Recovery opening recommended within 10 minutes; 95 percent within 30 minutes; root transaction within 80 days
Receiving PSP notification analysis 7 calendar days; payer PSP return request within 72 hours after analysis; receiving PSP return step up to 6 hours sequentially
Monitoring and partial returns can continue up to 90 days from original transaction
Ordinary wrong-destination payment is not an operational-failure MED case
does_not_support: South African PayShap remedy rights or time targets
Automatic legal ownership of fungible funds in a downstream account
A graph edge being equivalent to a hold or a returned payment

source_register.title: FAQ — Mecanismo Especial de Devolução (MED)
supports: Customer should report suspected fraud to its institution
Recovery process traces recipient accounts and downstream suspected recipients
Receiving PSPs block available resources up to requested transaction amount and assess notifications
does_not_support: Guaranteed recovery when funds have been dissipated
Application of Pix rules to PayShap or another jurisdiction

source_register.title: BC aprimora experiência do usuário no Pix e amplia proteção contra fraudes
supports: Pix User Experience Manual version 7.4 published 3 September 2026
Notice describes clearer MED contestation journey and restriction on unrelated advertising or hyperlinks in payment receipts
